name: VA-11 Hall-nyA
source:
In this world, corporations reign supreme, all human life is infected with nanomachines designed to oppress them, and the terrifying White Knights ensure that everyone obeys the laws.

But, this is about cat girls.

Specifically, this is a mod for VA-11 Hall-A, a Visual Novel released by Sukeban Games back in 2016.

[Edited from [url=https://requiell.itch.io/va-11-hall-nya-mod]itch.io[/url]]
